activation.title: Preparing your cloud desktop
activation.readyHint: You can now use sandbox tools or open the cloud desktop from the sidebar.
activation.hint: Payment confirmed. Your desktop is being prepared automatically. You can keep chatting or close this page; setup continues and its saved progress returns when you reopen it.
activation.attentionHint: The cloud purchase outcome is unclear. We are looking for the original desktop and will not buy a duplicate. Please contact an administrator to verify the cloud order.
activation.retrying: Setup could not finish yet. The server will retry automatically. You do not need to pay again.
activation.reconnecting: Reconnecting to get the latest status. The last saved progress is shown above.
activation.retryFailed: The retry request failed. Try again later; the background task will continue.
activation.subscriptionRequired: Cloud desktops require a paid plan
activation.subscriptionHint: Free users can continue ordinary LLM conversations. A paid plan automatically enables the sandbox. After expiry, your desktop is retained and reused on renewal if it still exists in the cloud.

review.emptyHint: When the agent edits files, the diff shows up here.
